LAHORE HIGH COURT, LAHORE2021 PLJ 88

Zainab Bibi v. Commissioner Inland Revenue

Question of Law

Whether the learned Appellate Tribunal Inland Revenue was justified in holding that the assessment framed under section 122(5A) of the Income Tax Ordinance, 2001 was barred by limitation?

Discussion

The petitioner is a registered person engaged in the manufacture of textile goods. The impugned order proceeds on the assumption that the limitation period runs from the date of service rather than the date of the order. That assumption is not supported by the plain language of the Ordinance.

Reliance is placed on Commissioner Inland Revenue v. Pak Suzuki Motor Co., 2017 PTD 1234, wherein it was held that limitation is to be reckoned from the end of the financial year in which the order was made.

Conclusion

For the reasons recorded above, the reference is answered in the negative, against the department. Office shall send a copy of this judgment to the learned Appellate Tribunal under section 133(5) of the Ordinance.
